key_insight: VISTA Architect precomputes a provenance-linked clinical knowledge graph and timeline so LLMs can answer EHR queries from organized patient state instead of repeatedly rereading raw records.
clinical_relevance: In multidisciplinary tumor boards, this approach improved reconstruction of complex oncology histories, supporting faster and more reliable pre-visit preparation for case review.
method: Transforms longitudinal EHR notes into a persistent MEDS Graph with full source provenance.
Builds a Timeline Object Architecture (TOA) that deduplicates and orders clinically important events using graph-guided LLM extraction.
Uses an agentic interface to traverse from summarized patient state back to source documentation only when verification is needed.
evidence_signal: Across 1,180 patients and 17,700 variable-level evaluations, the system reached 96.4% accuracy (mean 9.75/10; 95% CI 96.1-96.7%) on 15 tumor board-salient variables.
watch_item: The system was demonstrated in thoracic oncology, so performance and workflow fit still need validation in other specialties and settings.
paper_title: VISTA Architect: A graph database-oriented health AI system demonstrated in multidisciplinary tumor boards
